metadata.title: Dentnord — Surgical guides for dental implants
metadata.description: Digital implant planning and custom surgical guides for dental clinics, planned and printed in Denmark.

meta.title: Dentnord — Precise surgical guides for implant dentists
meta.description: Send your CBCT and intraoral scan. Dentnord plans the implant positions with you and delivers a printed, sleeve-ready surgical guide to your clinic.

Permanently deletes the account and everything linked to it: {cases, plural, =0 {no cases} one {# case} other {# cases}} with {files, plural, =0 {no files} one {# file} other {# files}} ({size}) and {messages, plural, =0 {no messages} one {# message} other {# messages}}, plus the login, sessions and emails sent to them. The history keeps only that an admin deleted an account, with these counts.

intros.files: Upload the CBCT and the intraoral scan. Files go straight to our EU storage.
intros.review: Check everything once more. You can still go back and change it.

details.patientCodeHint: Your own reference, e.g. a journal number. Never a name or CPR number.
details.notesHint: Anything we should know: bone quality, prosthetic plan, deadlines. No patient names.

sites.chartHint: Seen from the front, as you face the patient. Use the arrow keys to move and Space to select.
sites.empty: No sites yet. Choose at least one tooth on the chart.

files.notConfigured: File uploads aren't available right now. Your draft is saved; come back to add the files.

CBCT.title: CBCT (DICOM)
CBCT.description: The whole DICOM export as one .zip, or single .dcm files.

INTRAORAL_SCAN.title: Intraoral scan
INTRAORAL_SCAN.description: Upper, lower and bite registration as .stl, .ply or .obj.

PHOTO.title: Photos
PHOTO.description: Clinical photos, if they help the planning.

OTHER.title: Other files
OTHER.description: Anything else: wax-ups, reports, previous plans.

zipHelp.title: How do I zip the DICOM folder?
zipHelp.windows: Right-click the DICOM folder → Send to → Compressed (zipped) folder.

files.fixProblems: Retry or remove the files that didn't upload.
files.interrupted: Upload interrupted. Remove it and add the file again.

errors.extension: this file type isn't accepted here
errors.tooLarge: the file is larger than 2 GB
errors.duplicate: this file has already been added
errors.tooManyFiles: this case already has the maximum number of files
errors.rateLimited: too many requests; wait a minute and retry
errors.sizeMismatch: the upload arrived incomplete; please retry
errors.partsMissing: the upload is incomplete; retry to finish it
errors.network: the connection was lost; it continues when you're back online
errors.notFound: this upload no longer exists; remove it and add the file again
errors.storage: file storage didn't respond; please retry
errors.forbidden: you can't upload to this case
errors.unauthorized: your session has ended; log in again
errors.partNumber: the upload is out of step; remove it and add the file again
errors.wrongState: files can't be added to this case right now
errors.notViewable: this file can't be shown in 3D
errors.storageQuota: your account's storage limit is reached; contact Dentnord

review.consent: I confirm that the patient has consented to sharing these scans with Dentnord for treatment planning, and that the files contain no patient names.

success.title: Case submitted
success.body: Thank you. We've received your case and will be in touch when the plan is ready for your review.

plans.approveStatement: I have reviewed the implant positions, sizes and guide design in this plan and approve it for production.
plans.title: Treatment plan
plans.preparing: Being prepared (not visible to the dentist)

next.SUBMITTED: We're checking your files. Next, we plan the implant positions and the guide.
next.NEEDS_FILES: We need more files before we can plan. Upload them below and send them to us.
next.IN_PLANNING: We're planning the implant positions and designing your guide. You'll get the plan to review.
next.AWAITING_APPROVAL: Your plan is ready. Review it in 3D, then approve it or request changes.
next.CHANGES_REQUESTED: We're updating the plan with your changes. You'll get a new version to review.
next.APPROVED: Thank you for approving. Your guide goes into production next.
next.IN_PRODUCTION: Your guide is being produced. We'll let you know when it ships.
next.SHIPPED: Your guide is on its way. Please confirm when it arrives.
next.DELIVERED: Delivered. Thank you, and good luck with the surgery.

approval.body: Review the implant positions, sizes and the guide design. You can look at the plan in 3D and read the report below.
approval.consentRequired: Please confirm that you have reviewed the plan.
approval.changesHint: What should we change? Be as specific as you can.

cancel.title: Cancel this case?
cancel.body: Dentnord stops working on it. This can't be undone.

form.label: Contact form

form.sentBody: We'll get back to you by email.

setup.title: Two-factor authentication
setup.intro: Add a second step to your login: a 6-digit code from an authenticator app on your phone.
setup.introRequired: Admin accounts are protected with two-factor authentication. Set it up once; after that you log in with your password and a code from your authenticator app.
setup.scanBody: Open an authenticator app (for example Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password), add an account and scan this code. Then enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
setup.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
setup.manualLabel: Can't scan it? Enter this key in the app:
setup.backupBody: If you lose your phone, each of these codes lets you log in once. Keep them somewhere safe, such as a password manager. They won't be shown again.
setup.savedConfirm: I have saved my backup codes

backup.fileHeading: Dentnord backup codes for {email}. Each code works once.

login.intro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login.introBackup: Enter one of your backup codes. Each code works once.

settings.statusOn: On. You log in with your password and a code from your authenticator app.
settings.statusOff: Off. You log in with your password only.
settings.regenerateBody: Your current backup codes stop working. Confirm with your password.
settings.regeneratedBody: Your new backup codes. The old ones no longer work.
settings.disableBody: You'll log in with your password only, and your backup codes stop working. Confirm with your password.
